title: Replace site logo with Terravedant logo

requirements.text: Add the user-uploaded Terravedant logo (IMG-20260210-WA0045-1.jpg) as optimized static logo assets under frontend/public/assets/generated in two sizes: 128x128 and 512x512.

quotes: The logo needs to be replaced with the terravedant logo

acceptanceCriteria: Two new image files exist at frontend/public/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_512x512.png.
The generated images are visually based on IMG-20260210-WA0045-1.jpg and are crisp at their target sizes.

requirements.text: Update frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts so BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard and BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large point to the new Terravedant logo asset paths.

quotes: The logo needs to be replaced with the terravedant logo

requirements.text: Ensure the site header renders the new Terravedant logo using BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard without layout regressions on mobile and desktop.

quotes: The logo needs to be replaced with the terravedant logo

acceptanceCriteria: The header logo image displayed in frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx updates to the new Terravedant logo after the asset/path changes.
Logo remains properly contained (no stretching/cropping) across breakpoints (sm, md, lg) with existing Tailwind classes.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not change immutable hook files under frontend/src/hooks (read-only).
nonGoals: Changing marketing copy or other branding text (e.g., 'Terra Vedant Tech') unless explicitly requested.
